Upstream microagents/radkit a2a-client 0.1.0. Apache-2.0. Client and typed protocol/SSE codecs are unchanged except bounded 1 MiB HTTP body/SSE frame ingestion before deserialization. Legacy package renamed to coexist with current client. No wire version translation.
Correct upstream send_message return type from full SendMessageResponse envelope to upstream SendMessageResult: post_rpc_request already unwraps JSONRPC envelope. Unpatched0.1 client wrongly expects nested envelopes and fails standards-compliant0.3 servers. This uses existing SDK union and codec; no protocol translation.
Additional bounded ingress safeguards: 8 MiB total SSE wire, 4096 SSE lines per chunk, 10000 JSON nodes/32-depth before typed decoding; SDK line loop uses a consumed cursor to avoid quadratic suffix copies, UTF-8 carries incomplete byte sequences between chunks. A JSONRPC error response to a streaming request remains typed error/code instead of losing it to Content-Type mismatch.
